summary: Comprehensive testing of Agreement/Contract System for Breamway Auto Transport CRM. All 20 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified agreements list, detail page, signature pad, public signing page, void/delete functionality, and status filters.

issues: React warning: <span> inside <option> - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality. This is from the visual editor wrapper.
Minor React warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement needed

Agreements list page loads at /agreements with data-testid
Agreements table shows agreement data (14 agreements found)
Status badges display correctly (Draft, Sent, Signed, Void)
New Agreement button navigates to /agreements/new

critical_code_review_comments: Agreement auto-fill from order works correctly on backend (customer_name, email, phone, vehicle_info, pickup/delivery locations, price, deposit, default terms)
Public endpoints correctly exclude signature_data from GET response
Status flow enforced: draft -> sent -> signed, and draft/sent -> void
Signed agreements correctly protected from edit/delete operations
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test agreements during testing (with TEST_ prefix in signer_name/special_conditions), cleaned up via TestCleanup class
context_for_next_testing_agent: Agreement/Contract system fully tested and working. Key features: 1) Create agreement from order with auto-fill, 2) Status flow: draft->sent->signed or draft/sent->void, 3) Digital signature via canvas-based signature pad, 4) Public signing page at /agreements/sign/:id (no auth required), 5) Signed agreements are read-only and cannot be deleted. Backend has both authenticated (/api/agreements/*) and public (/api/agreements/public/*) endpoints.

agreements_list.ui: Table with agreement#, order#, customer, vehicle, price, status, created date, actions

agreement_detail.ui: Form with customer info, vehicle, price, locations, special conditions, terms

agreement_signing.ui: Signature section with name input and drawable canvas
